name: Image Optimizer
author: Misty
overview: Image Optimizer makes collision-safe optimized copies of up to 64 JPEG, PNG, or WebP images with approachable quality and size presets.
capabilities: Optimize up to 64 images at once
Limit output dimensions with quality-focused presets
Show per-file outcomes and total space saved
permissions: Read images chosen in the native picker
Save new copies in a folder chosen for writing
getting_started: Open Image Optimizer and choose up to 64 JPEG, PNG, or WebP images.
Choose an output folder, quality, and maximum dimension.
Optimize copies. Completed copies stay in the chosen folder; cancellation discards unfinished output.
changelog: v0.4.0 - Replaced path-based commands with native file grants and Host-owned image conversion.
v0.3.0 - Initial production release with source preservation, cancellation cleanup, collision-safe naming, and bundled FFmpeg.
